originality.rationale: The accepted core is the full log-phase-dependent Poisson law for common labelled cherry pairs of two independently generated Patricia tries; the exact one-tree mean and dyadic periodicity are acknowledged as known. Inspected closest primary works do not derive r-way prescribed joint cherry probabilities for multiple tries. Earlier equivalent laws remain a stated historical risk.
residual_risks: A historically uncatalogued coincidence theorem for independent tries or related digital search trees could imply the stated Poisson limit.
The Mahmoud/Ward 2008 original-publication month is verified, but its exact calendar day is not; dated archival metadata uses first-exact-day evidence from 2010 rather than inventing a 2008 day.
The q>=3 vanishing mean is immediate from the known p_n; its sharp probability asymptotic uses the joint second moment and is secondary to the Poisson theorem.

value.rationale: Exact labelled agreement of sibling pairs is a natural cross-index topology statistic for tries. The result establishes a whole probability law and a sharp two-vs-many collision regime and detects genuinely nonconvergent log-lattice modulation; it is not a one-tree mean recomputation or arbitrary finite table.
